job.title: Senior IT Architect / System Architect (all genders)

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer & E-Commerce Platform Engineer | Java & Spring Boot
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of experience building and scaling enterprise e-commerce platforms and digital systems using Java, Spring Boot, microservices and cloud deployments. Proven expertise in designing integrations, optimizing backend performance and collaborating across international agile teams at Rockwell Automation and Shell. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior IT Architect / System Architect (all genders)
cover_en.hook: I am eager to contribute my strong technical expertise in enterprise e-commerce platforms and scalable backend architectures to diconium. With over five years of professional experience building and scaling robust platforms using Java, Spring Boot, and microservices at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring a proven track record of designing complex integrations and aligning technical delivery with business strategy.

bullets.label: Enterprise E-Commerce Platforms
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud using Java and Spring, ensuring high performance, scalability, and adherence to clean design patterns.

bullets.label: Microservices & Backend Architecture
bullets.text: Engineered RESTful APIs, OCC web services, and backend data pipelines, driving seamless integration between complex enterprise systems like PIM, ERP, and MDM.

bullets.label: Agile & Technical Collaboration
bullets.text: Worked in techno-functional capacities within agile Scrum teams, bridging business requirements with technical execution and guiding international stakeholders through architecture decisions.

bullets.label: Performance Optimization & Cloud
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on cloud portals, optimized database queries to reduce latency, and maintained high reliability across distributed system environments.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German residence and work permit, and am available to start from 16 December 2026 following my notice period. I look forward to discussing how my background aligns with diconium's vision.

tailoring.why_company: I want to work at diconium because of your dedication to connecting software, data, and human expertise to drive measurable impact across global digital products. I am inspired by your collaborative, agile culture and the opportunity to help build and scale intelligent architectures for industry leaders.
tailoring.motivation_short: I am motivated to leverage my 5+ years of enterprise Java and e-commerce platform expertise to design robust system architectures and drive digital transformation at diconium.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years of enterprise Java and e-commerce architecture experience at Rockwell and Shell, I am very excited about diconium's digital projects. My CV and application for the Senior Architect role are attached—I'd love to connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Senior IT Architect / System Architect - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my application documents, including my CV and cover letter, for the Senior IT Architect / System Architect position at diconium.

With over 5 years of professional experience engineering scalable backend systems, Java and Spring Boot applications, and complex enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am confident in my ability to contribute effectively to your technology teams.

I hold a valid German work permit and am available to start from 16.12.2026. I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
